items.prompt: Minimal flat design, clean vector art style. A lone explorer character, depicted in full body with a confident stride, is holding an unfurled map. The explorer's entire body is clearly visible within the frame, with subtle 2-3 step cel-shading providing light volume. A thick, consistent black outline defines the subject. The scene is centered on a pure solid chroma key green (#00B140) background, with no gradients or textures on the background itself. The explorer and map fill approximately 80% of the 1:1 square frame, ensuring a small, clean margin of green background is visible on all four sides, preventing any part of the explorer's limbs or the map's edges from touching or being cropped by the canvas border. This composition is designed for immediate recognition even at thumbnail size, representing the concept of investigation and exploration universally. Absolutely no text, numbers, or watermarks. The style is that of professional stock illustration suitable for business presentations.
